slides.say: React sorts updates into two kinds: urgent updates, and transition updates.

slides.text: Urgent: typing, clicking, pressing. Must respond immediately.
slides.say: Urgent updates reflect direct interaction, like typing or clicking. They must feel instant, like physical objects.
Transition updates move the UI from one view to another. One input can trigger both kinds.

slides.text: Transitions can be interrupted; stale work is thrown away.
slides.say: Transition work is interrupted by urgent updates. If the user keeps typing, React throws out the stale render and only renders the latest.
